subject: Re: Acme POC — access, success criteria, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>, Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC — access, success criteria, next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. As discussed, below is a short recap, proposed success criteria, and the immediate asks so we can get the POC scheduled and the test environment provisioned.

Recap / goal: Run a 2-week POC to validate Redwood Inference for Acme's internal summarization and customer support routing workflows. We want to validate throughput at 200 qps equivalent and response quality vs your current baseline.

Proposed success criteria (agree or tweak):
- Functional: Summaries meet or exceed current NLG baseline on our eval set (ROUGE/SBERT + manual spot checks)
- Reliability: 99.5% of requests complete <350ms p50 during steady-state test (200 qps traffic pattern)
- Integration: SSO-based SAML sign-on for the test group + API key access for systems integration
- Security: IP allowlist for outbound requests, audit log access for the trial period

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Provision access and keys by Fri, Oct 30 (Rishi)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@acmecorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, security@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC — access, success criteria, next steps

Thanks Marissa — that looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- Success criteria: we want to add a latency SLA for p95 (<600ms) during the peak ramp tests. Also will run a quality eval with our 250-case customer ticket set (we'll provide the dataset).
- Access: please send SSO invites for these users: lena.gomez@acmecorp.com, dev-team@acmecorp.com (group alias). Our security team (security@acmecorp.com) will review the IP allowlist and SOC artifacts.
- Technical questions: what is the API key TTL for test keys, and are we able to restrict keys to a read-only model/namespace? Also what rate limits will be applied during the POC?

I've attached the internal evaluation spreadsheet and security contact.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of AI Platforms
Acme Corp
[attachment: internal_eval_set.csv (csv, 1.2MB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>, Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC — access, success criteria, next steps

Appreciate the quick response, Sanjay — helpful notes. Short answers to your technical questions: yes, we can issue test API keys with restrictive scopes and 30-day TTL by default (Rishi will confirm). We can also apply per-key rate limits and provide a dedicated test model variant for evaluation.

Next steps / owners: 
- Rishi (cc'd) to provision API key(s), open a test model namespace, and share connection details by EOD Fri, Oct 30.
- Redwood to send SSO invites to the two addresses Sanjay listed; please confirm any additional users.
- Kickoff run (traffic + quality eval) — proposed Mon, Nov 2; post-run checkpoint Fri, Nov 13.

I've attached our quick-start access guide and a one-pager for the POC plan. If the timeline works, we'll get everything provisioned this week so you can start the evaluation next week.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: access_instructions.md (md, 6KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC — access, success criteria, next steps

Hi all — looping back with the provisioning details. Per Marissa's notes I created a restricted test API key and opened a test namespace for Acme. Key metadata (do not treat as a production secret; this is a test stub): redwood-test-acme-xxxxxx (will be rotated after the POC). The key scope is limited to the 'acme-test' namespace and is rate-limited to 500 requests/minute.

IP allowlist: please add these CIDRs to your outbound allowlist so our infra accepts requests from your test runners:
- 52.15.128.0/24
- 34.213.64.0/24

SSO: I sent SAML invites to lena.gomez@acmecorp.com and dev-team@acmecorp.com via your Okta tenant; you should see the app in the Acme admin console.

Sample curl to validate connectivity:
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/acme-test/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer redwood-test-acme-xxxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "Test summary"}'

Attachments: small usage example and quick troubleshooting steps. If your security team needs the SOC-2 artifact, Monica can coordinate a secure transfer.

I'll monitor logs during the first run and be available for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
